summary: NUOC is an autonomous, closed-loop edge-AI software platform developed to protect astronaut vision. It addresses the challenge of Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-Ocular Syndrome (SANS) by shifting space medicine from passive monitoring to active, automated prevention.   To achieve this, NUOC continuously calculates a real-time SANS Risk Score by fusing data from five non-invasive metrics: IJV ultrasound, PPLL, OAE acoustics, ONSD, and OCT scans. If the system detects a venous bottleneck and rising intracranial pressure, it waits for the astronaut to enter deep sleep and automatically triggers a two-step intervention. First, it activates a Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) device to simulate gravity and clear fluid congestion in the chest. Second, it applies targeted electrical stimulation (TENS) to the cervical lymph nodes, actively pumping trapped cerebrospinal fluid out of the brain.This solution is important because it stops irreversible structural eye damage before it occurs, ensuring astronaut health and mission viability for deep space exploration without requiring constant manual medical intervention.

NUOC: Autonomous SANS Prevention System

Tagline: Shifting space medicine from passive monitoring to active, closed-loop prevention.

The Problem: Passive Blindness

In zero gravity, bodily fluids shift upward, creating a venous "traffic jam" in the neck (Internal Jugular Vein). This traps cerebrospinal fluid in the skull, drastically raising intracranial pressure. This pressure ultimately crushes the optic nerve, causing Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-Ocular Syndrome (SANS) and irreversible vision damage. Currently, space agencies only monitor this decline—they do not actively stop it.

The Solution: The NUOC Closed-Loop Platform

NUOC is an edge-AI software platform that acts as an autonomous medical officer. It fuses multi-sensor diagnostics with automated physical interventions to drain the brain and normalize pressure before structural eye damage ever occurs.

How It Works

1. State-Machine Diagnostics (The Brain) Instead of looking at isolated metrics, NUOC fuses data from 5 non-invasive sensors into a chronological Risk State Machine:

  • IJV Ultrasound: Detects the root cause (venous bottleneck/stagnant blood flow).
  • PPLL Ultrasound: Acts as a cranial proxy, calculating rising Intracranial Pressure (ICP) based on skull compliance.
  • OAE & ONSD: Confirms the pressure is transferring to the ear and inflating the optic nerve sheath.
  • OCT Neural Network: An AI model trained on 85,000 images to instantly classify retinal damage (the final fail-safe).

2. Automated "Synthetic Gravity" Intervention (The Cure) NUOC does not wait for the eye to deform. If the algorithm detects a Venous Bottleneck ($P_1$) and confirms the astronaut has entered Deep Sleep (when the brain's natural glymphatic flushing is active), it automatically triggers a two-step physical therapy:

  • Step 1: The Mechanical Vacuum (LBNP) NUOC activates a Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) sleeping bag. This acts as artificial gravity, sucking excess fluid into the legs and clearing the congestion in the chest.
  • Step 2: Active Lymphatic Pumping (TENS) With the chest cleared, NUOC activates a Cervical TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) collar. Targeted electrical pulses force the smooth muscles of the cervical lymph nodes to spasm, aggressively pumping the trapped fluid out of the brain and into the cleared circulatory system.

The Impact

By synchronizing existing NASA hardware (LBNP) with targeted electrical stimulation via a smart AI controller, NUOC provides a flight-ready, zero-effort defense mechanism to protect astronaut vision on long-duration missions to Mars and beyond.
